jobs.title: Vice President of IT Management
jobs.description:
Company Description
Merchant Serv is a comprehensive merchant services provider that supports businesses with payment processing, point-of-sale (POS) systems, and virtual assistance solutions. The organization focuses on reducing or eliminating processing fees so businesses can reinvest savings into growth and operations. It offers secure, affordable, and powerful POS hardware tailored to small business needs, along with tools for online transactions, invoicing, recurring billing, and acceptance of major credit cards. Merchant Serv emphasizes personalized service, with local account executives collaborating closely with business leaders nationwide to design custom plans aligned with specific objectives. Prospective team members join a company committed to innovative, client-centric solutions in the payments and business services space.
Role Description
The Vice President of IT Management is a full-time remote role responsible for leading Merchant Serv’s overall information technology vision, strategy, and operations. This role oversees IT governance, infrastructure, security, and application environments that support payment processing platforms, POS solutions, and internal business systems. Day-to-day responsibilities include driving IT strategy and roadmaps, prioritizing and managing technology initiatives, and ensuring high system availability, scalability, and data protection. The Vice President of IT Management collaborates with executive leadership, product, operations, and client-facing teams to align technology investments with business goals and regulatory requirements. This role also leads and mentors IT teams, manages vendor relationships, monitors budgets and performance metrics, and continuously improves processes to support a secure, efficient, and innovative technology environment.
Qualifications

Strong foundation in information technology, including enterprise systems, infrastructure, cybersecurity, and cloud-based solutions.
Demonstrated experience in IT management and leadership, including building and guiding high-performing technical teams.
Proven ability to develop and execute IT strategy aligned with business goals, particularly in payments, financial services, or technology-driven organizations.
Expertise in project management and strategic planning to oversee complex, cross-functional IT initiatives and deliver them on time and within budget.
Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
Experience working in or supporting remote, distributed teams and using modern collaboration tools.
Knowledge of regulatory, compliance, and security standards relevant to payment processing and financial data (e.g., PCI-DSS) is highly beneficial.
Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field; advanced degree or relevant certifications (e.g., PMP, ITIL, CISSP) are a plus.

We believe in the importance of in-office collaboration and fully intend for the selected candidate for this role to work on site in the specified location(s).

As Schwab continues to expand its technology footprint across cloud, artificial intelligence, digital platforms, applications & APIs, and infrastructure services, the Technology Risk Management (TRM) team plays a critical role in helping ensure the company maintains a strong risk posture through independent oversight and risk-informed assurance activities.

TRM has an opening in the Cyber Threat & Insider Risk discipline for an individual contributor to serve as the primary subject matter expert for second line oversight, effective challenge, and risk reporting of Security Operations, Digital Forensics, and Incident Response capabilities, processes, and controls. Success requires a self-starter attitude, strong desire to learn, building collaborative relationships with business partners, and the ability to assess and communicate technical risk clearly to executive, committee, regulatory, and technical audiences.

Lead global CIRT operations, including follow-the-sun coverage, escalation, containment, recovery, closure, and continuity during outages.
Oversee managed detection and response providers, including readiness, governance, performance, escalation quality, budgets, licensing, and commitments.
Advance responsible AI-assisted triage, investigation, decision support, documentation, and response with oversight, approvals, auditability, and reversibility.
Own the Cyber Defense digital twin roadmap and operationalize capabilities by defining use cases, requirements, success measures, acceptance, adoption, and legacy retirement.
Direct incident response; govern non-destructive containment and automated actions; and engage Investigations, Threat Hunting & Forensics when required.
Monitor response time, escalation and case quality, automation effectiveness, queue health, service levels, and corrective actions.

Partner with Cyber Threat Intelligence, Threat Exposure Management, Vulnerability Management, Security Engineering, and Enterprise Technology to improve response.

Lead executive briefings, stakeholder updates, reporting, communication cadence, and documentation of significant decisions.
Coordinate response with crisis, communications, legal, privacy, human resources, procurement, continuity, and technology operations teams.
Lead executive tabletop, functional, and technical exercises; maintain the roadmap and close corrective actions.
Lead post-incident reviews and incorporate technical findings and root-cause lessons into playbooks and readiness activities.
Build CIRT leadership depth through coaching, exercises, structured development, and clear performance expectations.

Apply incident response, recovery, crisis communications, business continuity, and crisis coordination practices during high-pressure events.
Translate issues into business terms and coordinate concurrent workstreams using risk-based decisions.
Integrate FDA, HIPAA, SEC cyber disclosure, sanctions compliance, and other reporting considerations into response processes.
Address threats involving contractors and contingent workers through identity verification and access revocation coordination.
Participate in after-hours or on-call incident response and crisis management activities as required.

jobs.description:
About Innovas

At Innovas, we are transforming the way government innovates by delivering the mechanisms that turn ideas into action. We bring together the right people, processes, and technologies to accelerate progress where it matters most.

With a focus on impact over bureaucracy, collaboration over silos, and solutions over status quo, we we're built to act. Our team is made up of passionate problem-solvers, innovators, and experts who thrive on tackling meaningful challenges and delivering results. At Innovas, every role contributes to something bigger. Whether you’re supporting technology acquisition, improving processes, or enabling collaboration across organizations, your work helps move critical missions forward.

Join Innovas and help shape the future of government innovation.

Why Work At Innovas

Work on problems that matter.

At Innovas, your work directly supports innovation that shapes our nation’s future and delivers solutions with real-world impact.

Be part of something built differently.

Our teams are empowered to focus on solving problems, creating value, and exceeding expectations.

Bring ideas to life.

Work alongside passionate problem-solvers who thrive on tackling complex challenges and turning possibilities into progress.

Grow alongside a team of experts.

Our people bring diverse experiences from government, military, industry, technology, and entrepreneurship.

Job Description

The Chief Technology Officer (CTO) sets and leads the technology strategy that powers the next generation of government innovation. This is an opportunity to build technology capabilities, products, and platforms that remove barriers between innovative ideas and critical solutions that support our clients' missions.

As Innovas grows, the CTO will advance the current internal technology environment while developing market changing external products, platforms, and capabilities that shape its future. The CTO provides executive leadership across enterprise applications, product development & engineering, artificial intelligence, cybersecurity & internal IT, infrastructure, data strategy, and systems integration. Working closely with executive leadership and business stakeholders, this role develops technology capabilities that improve organizational performance, accelerate product innovation, strengthen cybersecurity, and deliver secure, scalable solutions for government customers and employees. The CTO ensures technology investments align with business strategy, protects Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI), and positions the company for long-term growth.

The successful candidate is an executive builder with a demonstrated ability to lead multiple technology disciplines and attract and develop exceptional talent. They bring strong business acumen and experience managing technology investments, budgets, and resources in support of strategic priorities and profitable growth. The ideal candidate leads with accountability and a willingness to roll up their sleeves to deliver results.

Executive Technology Leadership and Strategy

Develop and execute an enterprise-wide technology strategy that supports organizational growth, operational efficiency, and long-term scalability.
Provide executive guidance on technology investments, modernization priorities, and digital transformation initiatives.
Own technology budgeting, investment planning, and resource allocation, evaluating build, buy, partner, or acquire options through cost, ROI, capacity, risk, and long-term value analysis to determine the best use of company resources.
Build, mentor, and oversee high-performing teams across all internal and external technology functions including enterprise applications, product development & engineering, artificial intelligence, cybersecurity & internal IT.
Manage relationships with technology vendors, SaaS providers, MSPs, and system integrators, and support contract evaluation, renewal strategy, licensing optimization, and cost management.
Work with executive team to strengthen cross-functional engagement and drive organization-wide adoption of technology and security practices.
Provide coaching, development, and clear expectations to ensure operational excellence and professional growth.

The CTO Is Accountable For Building And Leading The Technology Organization, Establishing Strong Functional Leadership, And Ensuring The Performance And Success Of The Following Teams And Capabilities

Product Development & AI Strategy

Partner with Product, Innovation, Growth, and business leaders to evaluate new product opportunities, determine technical feasibility and investment requirements, and move solutions from concept through deployment.
Lead software engineering, overseeing technical architecture, application development, DevOps, QA and testing, and the release and production support lifecycle.
Establish engineering standards, development practices, release management, documentation, and technology governance across all product lines.
Define and execute the company’s AI strategy, identifying opportunities to embed AI into products, enterprise platforms, and internal operations.
Establish the architecture, data, security, governance, and development standards required to deploy AI capabilities in government environments.

Enterprise Systems, Infrastructure, & Data

Governance

Lead enterprise system implementations, including CRM, ERP/finance, CLM, member platforms, and program management systems.
Establish enterprise standards for system architecture, resilience, performance, and service continuity.
Oversee integration strategy using APIs, middleware, automation frameworks, and MDM principles to maintain a single source of truth.
Partner with operations on change management, system sustainability, documentation, and operational performance across all major platforms.
Build and maintain secure and scalable data environments, including an enterprise data lake, data warehouses, and reporting ecosystems.
Define and enforce data governance standards covering taxonomy, metadata, lineage, retention, and quality.
Ensure data architecture supports analytics, forecasting, reporting, and emerging AI-enabled capabilities.

Cybersecurity, Compliance & Risk Management

Lead the company’s cybersecurity program, including policy development, identity and access controls, vulnerability management, and continuous monitoring.
Ensure compliance with federal frameworks, including NIST 800-171, CUI handling, DFARS requirements, CMMC readiness, and FedRAMP-aligned controls.
Develop systems and processes to manage classified data as required.
Own technology and cybersecurity risk management in alignment with federal and contractual requirements.
Oversee incident response, audit preparation, third-party security evaluations, and remediation planning.
Serve as the primary liaison with auditors, compliance consultants, and government technology representatives.

Internal IT & Employee Support

Lead internal IT operations and employee technology support, including help desk, service delivery, Microsoft 365 administration, cloud environments, network administration, and endpoint management.
Oversee employee technology onboarding and offboarding, account provisioning, device deployment, access management, and IT ticket escalation.
Establish service standards, SLAs, escalation procedures, and support processes that ensure responsive and reliable employee technology support.
Own endpoint and device management, including configuration, security, patching, monitoring, and ongoing administration.
Oversee IT asset management and the full asset lifecycle, including procurement, inventory, assignment, maintenance, replacement, recovery, and disposition.
Ensure business continuity, disaster recovery readiness, infrastructure reliability, and long-term modernization of the employee technology environment.

Qualifications

Must be a U.S. citizen with an ability to obtain security clearance.

Education Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field.

Experience And Skills

15+ years of progressive technology leadership, including experience as a CTO, CIO, or senior technology executive leading and scaling multidisciplinary technology organizations.
Proven success building technology teams and capabilities through significant organizational growth, maintaining an entrepreneurial, hands-on approach while establishing the structure required to scale.
Demonstrated ownership of enterprise technology strategy, budgets, investment priorities, workforce planning, and resource allocation.
Proven expertise evaluating and executing build, buy, partner, or acquire strategies, including technology due diligence, M&A integration, and investment analysis.
Strong business and financial acumen with the ability to connect technology investments and resource decisions to growth, profitability, customer value, and long-term enterprise value.
Demonstrable success leading the development and commercialization of complex software products and platforms, with a strong understanding of software engineering, product development, AI/ML, technical architecture, and modern development practices.
Proven ability to build and lead cross-functional technology organizations where engineering, product, business, security, and operations work together to move products and capabilities from concept through deployment.
Demonstrable success leading distributed teams and developing strong functional leaders who can scale their organizations while maintaining accountability, speed, and execution.
Proven expertise in advising executive leadership on technology strategy, emerging technologies, cybersecurity and enterprise risk, M&A, and major investment decisions.
Experience operating in government or highly regulated environments, with responsibility for CUI, cybersecurity, compliance, and technology risk strongly preferred.

Preferred Experience
